articles.title: Arax Investment Partners Acquires $1.5 Billion Cleveland Advisory Firm
articles.mainIdea: Arax Investment Partners Acquires $1.5 Billion Cleveland Advisory Firm
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Arax Investment Partners Acquires $1.5 Billion Cleveland Advisory Firm. Arax Investment Partners is continuing its acquisition campaign, adding GFP Private Wealth, a Cleveland-based registered investment advisory firm with $1.5 billion in assets under management. GFP, founded in 1978, bills itself as Ohio’s “first wholly woman-owned RIA.” Today, the firm is led by CEO Carina Diamond, who says that joining Arax will help the 27-person team improve its service model.
